articles.summary: Three-year partnership includes matching $1 million commitments from Noah and FIGS to Undue Medical Debt FIGS, Inc. (NYSE: FIGS), the global leading healthcare apparel brand, together with FIGS Global Brand Ambassador Noah Wyle, today announced a three-year partnership with Undue Medical Debt to relieve at least $200 million of medical debt for those families most burdened nationwide. Through their partnership, Noah and FIGS are each donating $1 million over the next three years to Undue Medical Debt, a national nonprofit that permanently abolishes on average $100 of qualifying medical debt for every $1 donated. This commitment is projected to relieve at least $200 million of medical debt for more than 150,000 burdened Americans, with the first round of debt relief from these donations taking place in time for the upcoming holidays. Our nation’s mounting medical debt is devastating patients and healthcare professionals alike. While the devastation to patients is better understood –
articles.title: Noah Wyle and FIGS Partner Together to Relieve At Least $200 Million of Medical Debt Nationwide
